title: At the shop
description: Ask for prices, compare items, and shop politely.

introduction.headline: Shop with confidence
introduction.body: Learn useful phrases for buying things, asking about prices, and comparing products.
introduction.bodyIt: Impara frasi utili per comprare, chiedere i prezzi e confrontare i prodotti.

vocabulary.example: This bread is cheaper than that one.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Questo pane costa meno di quello.

exercises.prompt: How do you ask about cost?
exercises.explanation: How much is it? is the standard way to ask about price.

exercises.prompt: This milk is ____ than that one.
exercises.promptIt: Completa: This milk is ____ than that one.
exercises.explanation: Use cheaper to compare two prices.

review.tip: Practise asking for the price of three items you buy regularly.
